title: 9 Things a Godly Man Never Does When He's Winning
caption:
Nine things a godly man never does when he's winning. Not even on the small wins.

He doesn't bring it up first. He doesn't skip the thank-you. He doesn't let the highlight replace the discipline that built it.

Standing tall and staying on your knees were never supposed to cancel each other out.

#faith #humility #christianmen #character #manofgod
